headline: Tidier screens verified locally: Profile, Settings and dedicated guides.
summary: Latest owner correction: safety instructions must not appear on Profile. General guidance stays in the Safety Center; essential contextual report/block controls remain available. Simplify each screen around its main task.

Profile now focuses on personal details and editing, with activity history collapsed. Account administration moves intact to authenticated Settings: email/sign-in, notifications, devices/sessions, data export/deletion and conditional billing. Account menu and verification recovery links reach the new destination.

Hosting guidance is preserved on its own Hosting Guide page; hosting and event creation use concise links. The shared footer is compact dedicated help/legal/support links, without repeated guidance or privacy-grade claims. Safety instructions remain in the Safety Center; contextual report/block controls are unchanged.

Verified 1,206 web tests (14 skipped), typecheck, production build, lint (0 errors/11 existing warnings) and actual-page synthetic browser checks at 390px normal/reduced motion and 1280px. Settings disclosures work by keyboard and fit mobile. Coordinator completed the slice directly; additional delegation was unavailable due to thread limit.

Production remains approved release d7064b7; current design/signup/HQ and isolated chat/host work are not deployed. Unattended CLI worker is fault-latched after an explicit usage limit, not working in the background. Host-edit work is preserved; no paid fallback, purchase or resume. Next: verify retained host-edit changes and assemble an exact release candidate. Continuous unattended work cannot be claimed until model capacity is restored.
